01The opportunity

A rare parcel on the Las Huacas hill.

Large ocean-view lots above Playa Guiones rarely come to market. This one pairs 2,588 m² of land with an existing home, in the neighborhood Nosara buyers ask for by name.

The asset

Land, view and a home in place.

An excellent ocean view across a 2,588 m² parcel, larger than every comparable in this analysis, with a traditional Costa Rican home that is usable from day one.

The buyer

Building or renovating in Nosara.

North American and European buyers who want to design a home on the hill, plus investors looking for a central parcel with room for a main house and a guest house.

The location

Minutes to the surf.

Las Huacas sits above Playa Guiones and Playa Pelada, with paved access, roving 24-hour security and a short drive to restaurants, schools and services.

04The plan

Five moves from launch to offer.

  1. Film the view and the land

    Drone and on-the-ground film of the ocean view, the parcel and the neighborhood: a full YouTube tour plus vertical cuts for Reels and TikTok.

  2. Straight to buyers already looking

    The listing and film go to KRAIN's database of active Nosara and Guanacaste buyers, investors and builders on day one.

  3. Published everywhere

    All KRAIN platforms, then syndication to Luxury Portfolio International, Leading Real Estate Companies of the World, Mayfair International, JamesEdition, Realtor.com and Omni MLS.

  4. Paid reach

    Funded Instagram, Facebook and Google campaigns aimed at Costa Rica second-home buyers in North America and Europe, with weekly reporting to Tim and Sue.

  5. The local agent network

    Through KRAIN's "We Care, We Share" policy, Nosara and Guanacaste agents can share our marketing directly with their own buyers.

08Recommendation

Why we recommend this price.

Villa La Ventana is the main reference. An older Las Huacas hilltop home marketed for renovation, it sold from a $1,595,000 list on 1,589 m². Tim and Sue's parcel is 63% larger, while Ventana offered a larger four-bedroom home with an attached apartment, which places this property just below that list.

Casa Brisas Tropical sets the floor. It asks $1,200,000 for a 2011 home on a similar half-acre lot without a strong ocean view. The excellent view here earns a clear premium above it.

The top of the hill puts the price in context. Atrium House and Courtyard House ask over $2,000 per m² of land with finished Studio Saxe architecture. This parcel gives a buyer the land and the view to build at that level.

This range is current market value. At about $512 to $551 per m², the property sits below every full-view lot and finished home on the hill, which positions it to draw strong interest early.
